runs.conclusion:
## 结论

618 期间整体 GMV 并未增长，反而较基线期下降：总 GMV 从基线期 4,067,009.33 元降至 618 期 4,009,029.94 元，净减少 57,979.39 元 [E2]。因此「GMV 增长由哪些渠道贡献」的前提不成立——四渠道中唯一正增长的是 **web**（+27,914.51 元）[E2]；GMV 下滑主要由 **live**（-51,514.98 元，占降幅 88.85%）和 **app**（-31,191.64 元，占降幅 53.80%）拖累，mini 基本持平（-3,187.28 元）[E2]。

|---|---|---|
| 618 活动区间 / 类型 | 2026-05-31 至 2026-06-18 / discount | [E1] |
| 基线期总 GMV | 4,067,009.33 元 | [E2] |
| 618 期总 GMV | 4,009,029.94 元 | [E2] |
| 总增量 | -57,979.39 元 | [E2] |

## 局限与说明

- **贡献占比符号**：contribution_pct 为「渠道增量 ÷ 总增量」，因总增量为负，负增长渠道呈正百分比（表示对降幅的贡献，如 live 88.85%）；web 的 -48.15% 表示其正增长抵消了约一半降幅 [E2]。

questions.question: 2026 年 8 月香水 GMV 环比变化主要来自哪些二级类目

runs.conclusion:
## 结论

2026 年 8 月香水（category_l1）GMV 环比 7 月整体上升，增长主要由**女士香水**驱动：其 GMV 由 355,641.10 元增至 445,447.38 元，环比增加 **+89,806.28 元**，对整体环比变化的贡献度约 **68.75%**，是第一大来源 [E1]。其次为**男士香水**，由 189,126.24 元增至 227,374.56 元，环比增加 **+38,248.32 元**，贡献度约 **29.28%** [E1]。**香氛礼盒**贡献最小，由 148,348.00 元增至 150,917.07 元，环比仅增加 **+2,569.07 元**，贡献度约 **1.97%** [E1]。三个二级类目均为正向增长，无下降类目。

## 数据与证据

| 二级类目 | 2026-07 GMV（元） | 2026-08 GMV（元） | 环比变化额（元） | 贡献度 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 女士香水 | 355,641.10 | 445,447.38 | +89,806.28 | 68.75% | [E1] |
| 男士香水 | 189,126.24 | 227,374.56 | +38,248.32 | 29.28% | [E1] |
| 香氛礼盒 | 148,348.00 | 150,917.07 | +2,569.07 | 1.97% | [E1] |

## 局限与说明

- 状态为 answered，无失败或未完成步骤。
- GMV 口径：`order_items.unit_price × quantity`，仅统计订单状态为 paid/shipped/completed 的已支付订单，按 `paid_at` 落在 2026-07-01 00:00 至 2026-09-01 00:00（不含）划分两个月度整月 [E1]。
- 类目口径：`category_l1 = '香水'` 下的全部二级类目共 3 个（女士香水、男士香水、香氛礼盒），已全部覆盖，无遗漏类目。
- 贡献度为各二级类目环比变化额占香水整体环比变化额的比例；因三类均为正增长，贡献度合计为 100%。
evidence_sqls: WITH monthly AS (SELECT p.category_l2 AS dim, TO_CHAR(o.paid_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS period, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.paid_at < CAST('2026-09-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND p.category_l1 = '香水' GROUP BY 1, 2), pivoted AS (SELECT dim, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-07' THEN gmv END), 0) AS gmv_prev, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN gmv END), 0) AS gmv_curr FROM monthly GROUP BY dim), total AS (SELECT SUM(gmv_prev) AS total_prev, SUM(gmv_curr) AS total_curr FROM pivoted) SELECT pv.dim, pv.gmv_prev, pv.gmv_curr, pv.gmv_curr - pv.gmv_prev AS gmv_change, CASE WHEN t.total_curr - t.total_prev <> 0 THEN (pv.gmv_curr - pv.gmv_prev) / (t.total_curr - t.total_prev) ELSE NULL END AS contribution FROM pivoted AS pv CROSS JOIN total AS t ORDER BY ABS(pv.gmv_curr - pv.gmv_prev) DESC LIMIT 1000

evidence_sqls: WITH period_gmv AS (SELECT p.category_l2 AS dim, CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' THEN '2026-08' ELSE '2026-07' END AS period, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND p.category_l1 = '香水' GROUP BY 1, 2), pivoted AS (SELECT dim, SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-07' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_base, SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_curr FROM period_gmv GROUP BY dim), totals AS (SELECT SUM(gmv_base) AS total_base, SUM(gmv_curr) AS total_curr FROM pivoted) SELECT p.dim AS category_l2, p.gmv_base, p.gmv_curr, p.gmv_curr - p.gmv_base AS gmv_diff, CASE WHEN p.gmv_base > 0 THEN ROUND((p.gmv_curr - p.gmv_base) / p.gmv_base * 100, 2) END AS change_rate_pct, CASE WHEN (t.total_curr - t.total_base) <> 0 THEN ROUND((p.gmv_curr - p.gmv_base) / (t.total_curr - t.total_base) * 100, 2) END AS contribution_pct FROM pivoted AS p CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY ABS(p.gmv_curr - p.gmv_base) DESC LIMIT 1000
